content.short: El Dorado is a Latin American app offering dollar accounts, currency exchange and card payments.
content.description: El Dorado is a peer-to-peer exchange for Latin American users buying and selling digital dollars, supporting more than eighty local payment methods. Trades typically settle in about a minute, with over fifty thousand positive reviews by the company's own count. Businesses can integrate the same liquidity through an API or embed it as a widget.
content.meta: Dollar accounts, FX and card spending across a dozen Latin American countries, built on stablecoins.
content.pageTitle: El Dorado - Web3 Wallet Tools - Lancers Web3 Explorer
